result.stdout:
temporal-sharp — static analysis and tooling for Temporal .NET workflows.

Usage: temporal-sharp [command] [options]

Commands:
  analyze (default)  Run the Kogoshvili.Temporal analyzers on a solution or project.
  map                Generate a workflow topology graph (mermaid, json, html, or dot).
  history            Download workflow histories for replay testing.
  preset             Generate a recommended or strict .editorconfig preset.

Usage: temporal-sharp analyze <path.sln|path.csproj> [options]

Options:
  --format <console|json|sarif>  Output format (default: console).
  --fail-on <none|info|warning|error>  Exit non-zero when a diagnostic of the
                                 given severity or higher is found (default: none).
  --severity <TMPxxxx=severity>  Override the severity of a rule (repeatable).

Error: Option '--out' is required.
Usage: temporal-sharp history download <workflowType> [options]

Downloads recorded workflow histories as *.json files for later replay.

Options:
  --execution-status <status>  Filter by execution status (default: Completed).
  --limit <n>                  Maximum number of histories to download.
  --out <dir>                  Directory to write *.json histories into (required).
  --config <path>              JSON config file (default: appsettings.json + Temporal__* env vars).
